list.name: direction
list.label: Direction
list.query: All : all,External → Internal : inbound,Internal → External : outbound,External → External : transit,Unclassified : unclassified
list.description: Derived from verified interface boundary metadata; never guessed.

panels.title: FLOW COLLECTION

targets.rawSql:
SELECT multiIf(countIf(Status = 'ACTIVE') > 0, 2, countIf(Status = 'IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS') > 0, 1, 0) FROM (SELECT l.exporter AS Exporter,
  multiIf(r.ex = '', 'NO DATA', x.ex != '', 'ACTIVE', 'IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS') AS Status,
  if(has([${device:singlequote}], l.exporter), 'Configured', 'NOT IN INVENTORY') AS Inventory,
  if(x.ex != '', x.bps, 0) AS Traffic, if(x.ex != '', x.fps, 0) AS `Flows/s`, if(r.ex = '', NULL, if(x.ex != '', x.age, r.age)) AS `Last flow`
  FROM (SELECT arrayJoin([${exporter:singlequote}]) AS exporter) AS l
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ExporterName AS ex, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows_1m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY ex) AS r ON l.exporter = r.ex
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ExporterName AS ex, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/300 AS bps, count()/300 AS fps, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY ex) AS x ON l.exporter = x.ex)

panels.description: RECEIVING FLOWS = at least one exporter sent flows in the last 5 minutes. IDLE = exporters seen in the last 7 days, none in the last 5 minutes. NO FLOW DATA = no exporter has sent flows in 7 days (expected in a lab without traffic). Neither is an outage: router availability is on the Device Health dashboard.

panels.title: SOURCE ASNs

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(SrcAS) FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}'))

panels.description: Distinct source ASNs (0 = unknown counts as one).

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(DstAS) FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}'))

panels.title: PUBLIC-ASN TRAFFIC

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * sumIf(Bytes*SamplingRate, (SrcAS != 0 AND NOT (SrcAS BETWEEN 64496 AND 65534) AND NOT (SrcAS BETWEEN 4200000000 AND 4294967294)) OR (DstAS != 0 AND NOT (DstAS BETWEEN 64496 AND 65534) AND NOT (DstAS BETWEEN 4200000000 AND 4294967294))) / greatest(1, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)), 1) FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}'))

panels.description: Share of traffic with a public (non-private, non-lab) ASN on either side. 0 % is expected for the private lab.

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (SELECT DstAS FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY DstAS ORDER BY sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) DESC LIMIT 6)
     SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) SECOND) AS time, multiIf(DstAS = 0, 'Private / Unknown ASN', DstAS BETWEEN 64496 AND 64511, concat('AS', toString(DstAS), ' (lab / documentation)'), DstAS BETWEEN 64512 AND 65534, concat('AS', toString(DstAS), ' (private)'), DstAS BETWEEN 4200000000 AND 4294967294, concat('AS', toString(DstAS), ' (private)'), concat('AS', toString(DstAS))) AS asn, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) AS bps FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND DstAS IN (SELECT DstAS FROM top) GROUP BY time, asn ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top source ASN

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label AS ASN, round(bytes*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime))) AS Traffic, round(100*bytes/sum(bytes) OVER (), 1) AS Share FROM (
     SELECT multiIf(SrcAS = 0, 'Private / Unknown ASN', SrcAS BETWEEN 64496 AND 64511, concat('AS', toString(SrcAS), ' (lab / documentation)'), SrcAS BETWEEN 64512 AND 65534, concat('AS', toString(SrcAS), ' (private)'), SrcAS BETWEEN 4200000000 AND 4294967294, concat('AS', toString(SrcAS), ' (private)'), concat('AS', toString(SrcAS))) AS label, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY label)
   ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 8

panels.description: Private / Unknown ASN = no ASN available (private or unrouted address). AS64496–64511 are documentation ASNs used by the lab. Organization names are not part of the enrichment data.

defaults.noValue: No traffic in the selected scope

panels.title: Top destination ASN

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label AS ASN, round(bytes*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime))) AS Traffic, round(100*bytes/sum(bytes) OVER (), 1) AS Share FROM (
     SELECT multiIf(DstAS = 0, 'Private / Unknown ASN', DstAS BETWEEN 64496 AND 64511, concat('AS', toString(DstAS), ' (lab / documentation)'), DstAS BETWEEN 64512 AND 65534, concat('AS', toString(DstAS), ' (private)'), DstAS BETWEEN 4200000000 AND 4294967294, concat('AS', toString(DstAS), ' (private)'), concat('AS', toString(DstAS))) AS label, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY label)
   ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: External vs internal

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) SECOND) AS time, multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'External → Internal', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'Internal → External', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'External → External', 'Unclassified') AS direction, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) AS bps FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY time, direction ORDER BY time

panels.description: Direction is derived from verified interface boundary metadata: External → Internal = enters through an external interface. "Unclassified" = neither side is marked external. Nothing is guessed.

defaults.noValue: No data in the selected range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT InIfProvider AS Provider, InIfConnectivity AS Type, ExporterName AS Exporter, round(sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime))) AS Traffic FROM default.${res}
     WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND InIfProvider != '' GROUP BY Provider, Type, Exporter ORDER BY Traffic DESC LIMIT 6

defaults.noValue: Provider classification pending — appears when interfaces carry provider metadata.

SELECT replaceAll(toString(DstCountry), '\0', '') AS Country, round(sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime))) AS Traffic FROM default.${res}
     WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND DstCountry != '' GROUP BY Country HAVING Country != '' ORDER BY Traffic DESC LIMIT 5
